+                                        val states = matchStates[index]

+                                            RAW_STRING_MISS -> false

+                                                states[stringId] = if (result) RAW_STRING_MATCH else RAW_STRING_MISS
+                                            }
                                         }
                                     }
+                                    index++
                                 }
                             }
                             if (matched) {
